# Bernardo Pereira — Portfolio Overview

> **Canonical URL:** [https://bernardope.com](https://bernardope.com)  
> **Type:** Personal Developer Portfolio  
> **Primary Language:** English  
> **Author:** Bernardo Pereira  

## Summary
This website serves as the central hub for Bernardo Pereira, a Lisbon-based MSc Computer Science & Engineering student and software engineer. It details his professional experience, academic background, open-source projects, technical skills, and provides an integrated AI chat assistant that can answer questions about his background.

---

## Site Architecture & Navigation
- **[Home](https://bernardope.com/)**: Introduction, high-level summary, and call-to-actions.
- **[Experience](https://bernardope.com/experience)**: Detailed work history, academic degrees, and comprehensive skill lists.
- **[Projects](https://bernardope.com/projects)**: Showcases featured repositories, including open-source contributions and full-stack side projects.
- **[AI Chat](https://bernardope.com/chat)**: An interactive LLM-powered agent trained on Bernardo's profile.
- **[Contact](https://bernardope.com/contact)**: Direct communication channels and links.
